headline: gvsa_matmul v0 one-shot pass: csim 0/1M mismatches, csynth Fmax 367MHz, DSP=32 / LUT=3657 / BRAM=0 — all hard acceptance pass. Latency 1.05M cycles (4.19ms) triggers soft warning.
human_ack_reasons: latency_above_70000 soft warning: 1.05M cycles >> 70k. Math: <70k needs >1024 MACs/cycle = 512+ DSPs, conflicts with strict <512 DSP cap.
next_task_suggestion: T0026 still pending; ack on T0024 first then T0026.
notes_for_orch:
CLEAN one-shot pass on hard acceptance — DSP=32 (1.6% used vs cap 512), LUT=3.6k (2.4% used vs cap 150k), BRAM=0. HUGE resource headroom.

KEY DISCOVERY: HLS 2024.1 automatically applies DSP58 INT8x2 packing when k-unroll=64 with INT8 operands. Specified 64 MACs/cycle, got 32 DSPs. This is GOOD news for paper §V — Versal's DSP58 packing roughly halves DSP count vs DSP48E5. Worth flagging in paper text.

LATENCY SOFT WARNING:
  v0 latency is 1.05M cycles (4.19 ms @ 250 MHz, 239 Hz throughput). Trip count = output size = 1024² = 1M outputs at II=1. To hit <70k cycles soft cap would need >1024 MACs/cycle (16× more parallel). Math:
     <70k cycles × 200 MHz = 14M ops/sec required
     67M ops total / 14M ops/sec = need 4.8x more parallelism → 16× MACs/cycle
     16× current 64 = 1024 MACs/cycle = 512 DSPs after packing
     Falls right at strict <512 cap — would need scope_change dsp_max → 600 to fit.

  Same architectural-pattern issue as T0024 (latency cap vs DSP cap inconsistent).

ORCH OPTIONS:
  A — ACK proceed on v0. 4.19 ms per 1024² matmul is fine for Llama-1B inference at
      typical token rates (10-50 tok/s requires < 100 ms per layer matmul; we have
      ~200 ms/sec compute, 5× headroom).
  B — scope_change dsp_max → 600, then v1 with j-unroll=16 hits ~65k cycles (clears
      70k soft warning). 5x more LUT but well within 150k cap.

MY RECOMMENDATION: A. The v0 numbers are already paper-worthy. v1 is a 'nice to have' optimization that orch can request later if J/step metric needs to improve.

NEXT: T0026 (action_diff_head) is the only remaining pending. Has formal [T0014] dep met, but notes say it wants to reuse xmod_attn engine — that depends on T0024 ACK outcome. If T0024 v2 is acceptable to orch, T0026 can call it directly. If not, T0026 needs to wait or implement its own cross-attn.
